thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx rates on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Alert ID: A-2026-4319. Trigger: 5xx > 5% for 3m.
jamie: I'm on it — seeing spike across gateway nodes, routing ~30% failures.
jamie: taking ownership, paging eng-runtime and eng-sre. @maria @lee please ack.
maria: ack. I'm pulling model-runner logs now.
lee: ack. Kicking short-circuit to fallback pool to reduce customer impact. Routing rule applied: route/model=latest -> fallback/model=stable-1.
jamie: thanks. tom, please prepare a brief customer note for affected customers (latency/errors).
tom: on it. I'll draft a status page update once we have root cause.
maria: log dump — multiple pods showing signal 11 (segfault) in model_runner at inference step. Sample: ```
[2026-03-17T12:40:21Z] model_runner[pid=2134]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f5c3b1a4f25 sp 0x7ffd8c3a1c40 error 4 in libattention.so
[2026-03-17T12:40:21Z] backtrace: 0x7f5c3b1a4f25 func_attention_forward +0x85
[2026-03-17T12:40:21Z] model_runner[pid=2134]: killed by signal 11
```
maria: also seeing OOM messages in adjacent pods around same time, e.g. "cgroup: memory limit exceeded". Could be memory corruption then crash.
lee: checking node-level OOM killer logs and GPU driver errors. Quick grep shows repeated GPU reset events around 12:40Z on node usw2-gpu-17.
jamie: hypothesis: recent quantized-attention kernel landing in runtime may be causing corruption under long sequences. That change rolled out ~12:10Z.
maria: I can repro locally with a stress prompt and the quantized kernel flag. Repro steps: ```
export RUNNER_FLAGS=--attn-kernel=quant_v2
python stress_infer.py --model redwood-v1-large --seq 8192 --concurrency 8
```
maria: crash reproduces in ~30-60s. Stack same.
jamie: good repro. Plan: 1) rollback quant kernel in prod model groups 2) drain/restart affected pods 3) monitor error rate and customer impact 4) prepare hotpatch if rollback not feasible quickly.
lee: rolling config change to route/model-group=latest -> model-variant=non-quant now (gradual 20% -> 100%). Applying now.
jamie: initiating drain of 5 pods on usw2-gpu-17 and restarting replica set. Maria, can you build and stage a hotpatch with a safer kernel (quant_v1) if rollback doesn't complete?
maria: yes. I have branch hotfix/quant-fallback with patched attention wrapper. Building image now (CI estimate ~8m).
tom: support note draft: "We are investigating elevated 5xxs affecting text generation in US-West. We've routed traffic to a stable model variant and are restarting affected infra. Customers may see transient retries. Will update in 15 minutes."
olivia: product: flagging major customers with SSO usage in us-west; coordinate postmortem framing and SLA offsets if needed.
jamie: monitoring dashboards — error rate already dropping from 5.3% -> 1.6% after routing change. Latency stable.
lee: GPU resets stopped on node after drains. No new segfaults in the last 2 minutes.
maria: CI image built. Deploying hotpatch to canary set (2 pods) with non-quant kernel for validation.
jamie: canary healthy. No 5xx in canary logs.
jamie: continuing rollout to remaining nodes, will keep fallback rule for another 30m.
tom: status page posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4319876543 — included step-by-step and ETA.
olivia: escalation: preparing customer comms for top 10 affected accounts, ops team to reach out.
maria: creating follow-up issue: runtime/quant-kernel-corruption with repro steps, test harness, and rollback checklist.
jamie: handing off to oncall rotation for continued monitoring. If error rate stays <1% for 15m, we'll close incident and schedule postmortem.
lee: leaving monitoring alerts muted for next 20m to avoid noise; keeping oncall channel pinned.
jamie: final note: root cause likely unsafe assumptions in quant_v2 attention kernel — rollback + hotpatch mitigated immediate customer impact. Postmortem to include regression tests and canary gating. :white_check_mark:
